scenes.title: The notice

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.stage_action: Sam enters the counter frame through the open doorway at an ordinary walking pace.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: You're early. I haven't even switched the front lights on.
beats.text_vi: Cậu đến sớm. Tôi còn chưa bật đèn phía trước nữa.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Six meant six. I didn't want you waiting for me.
beats.text_vi: Sáu giờ là sáu giờ. Cháu không muốn cô phải đợi.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: I wasn't expecting new shoes. Those look properly dry, anyway.
beats.text_vi: Tôi không ngờ cậu mua giày mới. Ít ra trông chúng khô ráo.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: The shop had one pair left that actually fit me.
beats.text_vi: Cửa hàng còn đúng một đôi vừa chân cháu thật sự.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Good. You can leave your coat on for a minute.
beats.text_vi: Tốt. Cậu cứ mặc áo khoác thêm một lát cũng được.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Is that notice on the counter meant for the window?
beats.text_vi: Tờ thông báo trên quầy kia là để dán lên cửa kính ạ?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.stage_action: Ruth places one empty white mug on the counter; Sam's hands remain away from it.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: I hadn't decided where it ought to go just yet.
beats.text_vi: Tôi vẫn chưa quyết định nên đặt nó ở đâu thôi.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: It says permanently. That's quite a word to leave out.
beats.text_vi: Nó ghi vĩnh viễn. Đó đâu phải từ có thể bỏ qua.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: I know what it says. I had it printed myself.
beats.text_vi: Tôi biết nó ghi gì. Chính tôi đã nhờ in mà.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Then should I have called before coming down this morning?
beats.text_vi: Vậy lẽ ra sáng nay cháu nên gọi trước khi đến ạ?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: No. You came when I asked you. You did right.
beats.text_vi: Không. Cậu đến đúng giờ tôi hẹn. Cậu làm đúng rồi.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: I thought the first thing would be learning the till.
beats.text_vi: Cháu tưởng việc đầu tiên sẽ là học dùng máy tính tiền.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: We can leave the till alone until we've had coffee.
beats.text_vi: Cứ để máy tính tiền đó đến khi chúng ta uống cà phê.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.stage_action: Sam picks up the white mug from the counter; Ruth's hands stay on her own side.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: This one's empty. Were you going to make some now?
beats.text_vi: Cốc này rỗng. Cô định pha cà phê bây giờ sao?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: I was going to ask if you still take milk.
beats.text_vi: Tôi định hỏi cậu còn uống kèm sữa hay không.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: I do, but coffee isn't why I came here today.
beats.text_vi: Có ạ, nhưng hôm nay cháu không đến đây vì cà phê.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: I didn't say it was. Please give me a minute.
beats.text_vi: Tôi đâu có nói thế. Cho tôi một phút đã nhé.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Was that notice printed before you offered me the job?
beats.text_vi: Cô in thông báo đó trước khi đề nghị nhận cháu sao?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Yes. It was already here when we talked that night.
beats.text_vi: Phải. Nó đã ở đây từ đêm chúng ta nói chuyện.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Then I need you to explain what I'm here for.
beats.text_vi: Vậy cháu cần cô giải thích cháu đến đây để làm gì.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.stage_action: Sam sets the mug down on the counter in its original place; Ruth does not reach toward it.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: All right. Let's sit where we can actually hear ourselves.
beats.text_vi: Được rồi. Hãy ngồi chỗ nào chúng ta nghe rõ nhau hơn.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

scenes.title: The morning she planned
scenes.goal: Sam asks whether the invitation was pity.
scenes.outcome: Ruth admits she planned a last morning together; Sam insists they discuss actual work.
scenes.setup_en: RUTH is standing beside the booth; SAM is standing at the counter. Props are preset between scenes; there are no other visible or audible people.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.stage_action: Sam walks out of the counter frame toward the booth; Ruth remains outside this frame.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: I thought we'd sit a while before doing anything else.
beats.text_vi: Tôi nghĩ mình sẽ ngồi một lát trước khi làm việc gì khác.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing beside the booth in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: You could have asked me for breakfast instead of work.
beats.text_vi: Cô có thể mời cháu ăn sáng thay vì hứa cho việc.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing beside the near booth seat in the next static setup in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: You might not have come if I'd called it breakfast.
beats.text_vi: Nếu tôi chỉ gọi là ăn sáng, có lẽ cậu đã không đến.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing beside the booth in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: You don't know that. You never gave me that choice.
beats.text_vi: Cô đâu biết được. Cô chưa từng cho cháu lựa chọn đó.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing beside the near booth seat in the next static setup in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: No. I didn't. I thought I was making it easier.
beats.text_vi: Phải. Tôi không cho. Tôi tưởng như vậy sẽ dễ hơn.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing beside the booth in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.stage_action: Sam sits down on the near booth seat; Ruth stays standing across the table.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Easier for which of us? I'm honestly asking you that.
beats.text_vi: Dễ hơn cho ai ạ? Cháu thực lòng muốn hỏi cô điều đó.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: For me, probably. I didn't want another morning here alone.
beats.text_vi: Chắc là cho tôi. Tôi không muốn lại ở đây một mình.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing beside the booth in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: So this was supposed to be your last morning here?
beats.text_vi: Vậy cô định coi đây là buổi sáng cuối cùng ở đây sao?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: One proper morning. Before I put that thing on display.
beats.text_vi: Một buổi sáng cho tử tế. Trước khi tôi treo thông báo đó.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing beside the booth in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: And I was supposed to sit here while you closed?
beats.text_vi: Còn cháu chỉ việc ngồi đây nhìn cô đóng cửa sao?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: I hadn't worked out what I'd say when you arrived.
beats.text_vi: Tôi chưa nghĩ ra sẽ nói gì khi cậu đến.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing beside the booth in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.stage_action: Ruth sits down on the opposite booth seat; the table remains between both actors.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: You told me six. I spent the night planning around it.
beats.text_vi: Cô hẹn sáu giờ. Cả đêm cháu đã tính toán theo lời hẹn.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: I meant that part. I wanted you to be here.
beats.text_vi: Phần đó là thật. Tôi muốn cậu có mặt ở đây.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Being here isn't the same as having somewhere to work.
beats.text_vi: Có mặt ở đây đâu có nghĩa là có nơi làm việc.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: No. It isn't. I should have said what was happening.
beats.text_vi: Không giống. Tôi lẽ ra phải nói rõ chuyện đang xảy ra.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: I can hear bad news. I can't plan around guesses.
beats.text_vi: Cháu nghe được tin xấu. Cháu không thể tính theo phỏng đoán.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Then ask me what you need to know. I'll answer.
beats.text_vi: Vậy cậu cứ hỏi điều cần biết. Tôi sẽ trả lời.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Is there any work here that you actually need done?
beats.text_vi: Ở đây có việc gì cô thực sự cần người làm không?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: There is plenty. I just can't promise where it leads.
beats.text_vi: Có rất nhiều. Tôi chỉ không hứa được nó sẽ dẫn đến đâu.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: I'm asking about this morning. Start with what's actually here.
beats.text_vi: Cháu đang hỏi sáng nay. Hãy bắt đầu bằng việc có thật.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.stage_action: Sam stands up beside his booth seat without approaching Ruth or touching the table.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: The counter needs setting. We can start with that much.
beats.text_vi: Quầy cần được chuẩn bị. Ta có thể bắt đầu từ việc đó.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

scenes.title: One place to start
scenes.goal: Sam wants a task with a clear beginning and end.
scenes.outcome: They define one manageable counter station; Ruth admits she needs help explaining the work.
scenes.setup_en: RUTH is standing behind the counter; SAM is standing on the customer side. Props are preset between scenes; there are no other visible or audible people.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Only this end first. The other stools can stay empty.
beats.text_vi: Trước mắt chỉ đầu quầy này. Các ghế còn lại cứ để trống.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: How many places do you normally set before opening up?
beats.text_vi: Thường cô chuẩn bị bao nhiêu chỗ trước khi mở cửa ạ?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: All eight, usually. Then the booths, if I have time.
beats.text_vi: Thường là cả tám. Rồi đến các bàn, nếu còn thời gian.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: You said this end. Does that mean two places today?
beats.text_vi: Cô nói đầu này. Vậy hôm nay chuẩn bị hai chỗ thôi ạ?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Two is enough for now. I keep forgetting that part.
beats.text_vi: Hai chỗ trước mắt là đủ. Tôi cứ quên mất điều đó.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.stage_action: Ruth places a second empty mug on the counter, well away from Sam's hands.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Do the handles face the person or face the till?
beats.text_vi: Quai cốc quay về phía khách hay về phía máy tính tiền ạ?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: The person, unless they're left handed and move it themselves.
beats.text_vi: Về phía khách, trừ khi họ thuận tay trái và tự xoay lại.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Good. That's something I can check without guessing your mind.
beats.text_vi: Tốt. Việc đó cháu kiểm tra được mà không phải đoán ý cô.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: You'll have to ask things. I haven't trained anyone lately.
beats.text_vi: Cậu sẽ phải hỏi nhiều đấy. Lâu rồi tôi chưa hướng dẫn ai.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: I can ask. Will you tell me when something matters?
beats.text_vi: Cháu hỏi được. Cô sẽ nói rõ khi việc gì quan trọng chứ?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Yes. And when it doesn't, I'll try to say that.
beats.text_vi: Có. Và khi không quan trọng, tôi cũng sẽ cố nói rõ.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.stage_action: Sam watches the two separate mugs in a still close-up, then holds a thoughtful expression.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Are these two clean, or are they waiting for washing?
beats.text_vi: Hai cốc này sạch rồi hay vẫn đang chờ rửa ạ?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Clean. The dirty ones stay in the tray behind me.
beats.text_vi: Sạch rồi. Cốc bẩn ở trong khay phía sau tôi.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

scenes.title: What today costs

beats.text_en: Before we do another job, we need to discuss pay.

beats.speaker: RUTH

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: For how many hours today, including the time we're talking?

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Six until nine. Forty five dollars for the whole morning.
beats.text_vi: Từ sáu đến chín. Bốn mươi lăm đô cho cả buổi sáng.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: And that's work, even if nobody comes through the door?

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Of course it is. You came here because I asked.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Can you pay that today, without using tomorrow's takings first?

beats.speaker: RUTH

beats.text_en: I need to ask. I've worked places that answered differently.
beats.text_vi: Cháu phải hỏi. Cháu từng làm ở những nơi trả lời khác.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: You don't need to explain why you want paying, Sam.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Then don't make that face when I ask about it.
beats.text_vi: Vậy khi cháu hỏi, cô đừng nhìn cháu như thế nữa.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: What face? I'm trying to remember where I put things.
beats.text_vi: Nhìn thế nào? Tôi đang cố nhớ mình để đồ ở đâu thôi.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: All right. I don't like admitting how little is certain.
beats.text_vi: Được rồi. Tôi không thích thừa nhận có quá ít điều chắc chắn.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: I don't need everything certain. I need today's part clear.
beats.text_vi: Cháu không cần mọi thứ chắc chắn. Cháu cần phần hôm nay rõ ràng.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Today is paid. Tomorrow is something we haven't agreed yet.
beats.text_vi: Hôm nay có lương. Ngày mai là chuyện ta chưa thỏa thuận.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: If today goes well, would there actually be another shift?

beats.text_en: I'll write today down. I won't write tomorrow in yet.
beats.text_vi: Cháu sẽ ghi hôm nay. Cháu chưa ghi thêm ngày mai đâu.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: That sounds fair. You can stop at nine without asking.
beats.text_vi: Như vậy công bằng. Đến chín giờ cậu nghỉ, không cần hỏi.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: If you're behind, I still stop unless we agree otherwise?
beats.text_vi: Nếu cô còn dở việc, cháu vẫn nghỉ trừ khi thỏa thuận thêm?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Yes. I won't keep you here by looking worn out.
beats.text_vi: Phải. Tôi sẽ không dùng vẻ mệt mỏi để giữ cậu lại.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Good. Then we can talk about the work without guessing.
beats.text_vi: Tốt. Vậy ta có thể nói về công việc mà không phải đoán.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

scenes.title: The old money
scenes.goal: They confront whether Sam's childhood debt is being carried into this job.
scenes.outcome: Sam keeps his savings; Ruth agrees the job must stand on its own terms.
scenes.setup_en: RUTH is standing behind the counter; SAM is standing on the customer side. Props are preset between scenes; there are no other visible or audible people.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: You haven't asked whether this changes what we discussed before.
beats.text_vi: Cậu chưa hỏi liệu chuyện này có thay đổi điều ta từng nói.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: I've been trying to keep those things apart this morning.
beats.text_vi: Sáng nay cháu vẫn cố tách riêng hai chuyện đó ra.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: I told you to buy shoes. I meant that, Sam.
beats.text_vi: Tôi bảo cậu mua giày. Tôi thực lòng nói vậy, Sam.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: I did. But the rest of that money is mine?
beats.text_vi: Cháu mua rồi. Nhưng số tiền còn lại vẫn là của cháu chứ?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Yes. It isn't a deposit on keeping this place open.
beats.text_vi: Phải. Đó không phải tiền đặt cọc để giữ quán mở cửa.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.stage_action: Sam remains still with both hands visible and empty; his jaw eases slightly.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: I needed you to say that without me offering first.
beats.text_vi: Cháu cần cô nói điều đó trước khi cháu lại đề nghị.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Were you going to offer? Please don't tell me yes.
beats.text_vi: Cậu định đề nghị sao? Đừng nói với tôi là có nhé.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: I thought about it when I saw the closed notice.

beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Then I gave you the wrong idea by hiding things.

beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: You made it hard to know what you actually wanted.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: I wanted someone here. I should have asked you plainly.

beats.speaker: RUTH

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: I can come for breakfast without buying part of your problems.

beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: You can. And you can take another job without asking.
beats.text_vi: Cậu có thể. Cũng có thể nhận việc khác mà không cần hỏi tôi.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Even if you teach me things and this goes badly?

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Yes. Teaching you doesn't make your next decision belong here.
beats.text_vi: Phải. Dạy cậu không khiến quyết định tiếp theo thuộc về quán.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: I don't want every mistake measured against what happened then.
beats.text_vi: Cháu không muốn lỗi nào cũng bị so với chuyện ngày trước.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Neither do I. But money mistakes will still need explaining.
beats.text_vi: Tôi cũng vậy. Nhưng sai sót tiền bạc vẫn phải giải thích rõ.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: That's fair, if you ask before deciding what I meant.

beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: I'll ask. You tell me straight, even when you're embarrassed.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: I can do that better if the answer isn't already chosen.

beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Then we'll both have something to practise while we're here.
beats.text_vi: Vậy cả hai đều có điều phải tập trong lúc ở đây.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: All right. My savings stay separate. So does this job.
beats.text_vi: Được ạ. Tiền dành dụm để riêng. Công việc này cũng vậy.

scenes.title: Why she was closing

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: What made you print the notice instead of asking for help?

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: I asked in little ways. Nobody knew what I meant.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: I kept thinking I'd manage until I found somebody else.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Was there somebody else coming, or were you just hoping?
beats.text_vi: Đã có ai định đến chưa, hay cô chỉ đang hy vọng?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Just hoping. Then I started leaving jobs for the next morning.
beats.text_vi: Chỉ hy vọng thôi. Rồi tôi bắt đầu dồn việc sang sáng sau.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.stage_action: Ruth places the folded closure notice on her own side of the booth table.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: I can still do the work. I can't do all of it.
beats.text_vi: Tôi vẫn làm việc được. Tôi không thể làm hết mọi việc.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Which part makes you want to turn round at the door?
beats.text_vi: Việc nào khiến cô muốn quay đi ngay khi đến cửa?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Opening everything when I know I'll be closing everything alone.
beats.text_vi: Mở hết mọi thứ, dù biết mình sẽ phải đóng hết một mình.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Then maybe everything is too much to open this week.
beats.text_vi: Vậy có lẽ tuần này mình không nên mở hết mọi thứ.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: People expect the booths, the hot food, all of it.
beats.text_vi: Mọi người mong có bàn, đồ ăn nóng, tất cả như trước.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.stage_action: Ruth stays seated, considering the empty booth opposite; no other people appear or speak.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: You don't have to promise every usual thing before breakfast.
beats.text_vi: Cô không phải hứa đủ mọi thứ thường ngày trước bữa sáng.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: I don't want them walking in and thinking we've given up.
beats.text_vi: Tôi không muốn họ bước vào rồi nghĩ chúng ta đã bỏ cuộc.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: They might think you changed the hours because you needed to.
beats.text_vi: Họ có thể nghĩ cô đổi giờ vì thực sự cần đổi.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: You make it sound simple. I know it won't be.
beats.text_vi: Cậu nói nghe đơn giản. Tôi biết sẽ không đơn giản đâu.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: I'm saying smaller. You can still tell me it's hard.
beats.text_vi: Cháu nói thu gọn thôi. Cô vẫn có thể nói là khó.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.stage_action: Sam places his closed notebook on his own side of the table, without crossing Ruth's reach.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: I wanted that notice to make the decision for me.
beats.text_vi: Tôi đã muốn tờ thông báo quyết định thay mình.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Do you want to close, if you can choose again?
beats.text_vi: Nếu được chọn lại, cô có muốn đóng cửa không?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: I want to stop doing mornings that leave me flattened.
beats.text_vi: Tôi muốn chấm dứt những buổi sáng làm mình kiệt sức.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: That's different. What would a morning you could manage look like?
beats.text_vi: Vậy là khác. Một buổi sáng vừa sức với cô sẽ thế nào?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: One counter. Short hours. And somebody telling me to stop.
beats.text_vi: Một quầy. Giờ ngắn. Và có người nhắc tôi dừng lại.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Let's work out that morning before we decide about forever.
beats.text_vi: Hãy tính buổi sáng ấy trước khi quyết định chuyện vĩnh viễn.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

scenes.title: A smaller opening
scenes.goal: They define what the diner can honestly offer with two inexperienced hands.
scenes.outcome: Ruth chooses counter-only service and takes responsibility for telling people the limits.
scenes.setup_en: RUTH is standing behind the counter; SAM is standing on the customer side. Props are preset between scenes; there are no other visible or audible people.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Coffee and toast first. That's what I could manage myself.
beats.text_vi: Trước tiên là cà phê và bánh mì nướng. Tôi tự lo được.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Can you manage both while showing me what to do?
beats.text_vi: Cô vừa lo cả hai vừa chỉ việc cho cháu được không?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: If you handle the clean cups and keep this counter clear.
beats.text_vi: Được, nếu cậu lo cốc sạch và giữ mặt quầy này thoáng.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: I haven't worked the machine. I shouldn't guess with that.
beats.text_vi: Cháu chưa dùng máy pha. Cháu không nên tự đoán cách dùng.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: You won't. I do the hot things until you've learned.
beats.text_vi: Cậu không cần. Tôi lo đồ nóng đến khi cậu học xong.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: And if somebody asks me for something we aren't serving?
beats.text_vi: Nếu có người gọi món mà chúng ta không phục vụ thì sao?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.stage_action: Ruth places a plain menu card flat on the counter, beyond Sam's hand space.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Tell them the choices. If they're unhappy, you call me.
beats.text_vi: Nói họ các lựa chọn. Nếu họ không hài lòng thì gọi tôi.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: You won't change your mind and start the whole kitchen?
beats.text_vi: Cô sẽ không đổi ý rồi mở lại cả bếp chứ?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: I might want to. You'll probably see it on my face.
beats.text_vi: Có thể tôi sẽ muốn. Chắc cậu sẽ thấy ngay trên mặt tôi.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Then give me something definite I can remind you of.
beats.text_vi: Vậy cô cho cháu một giới hạn rõ để cháu nhắc lại.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: No breakfast plates this week. Just the things we agreed.
beats.text_vi: Tuần này không làm suất ăn sáng. Chỉ những món đã thống nhất.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Do we leave the booths closed, even if they're empty?
beats.text_vi: Ta vẫn không phục vụ bàn, kể cả khi các bàn trống ạ?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Yes. Four counter seats, so I can see what's happening.
beats.text_vi: Phải. Bốn ghế ở quầy, để tôi theo dõi được mọi việc.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: You said two places earlier. Are we changing that already?
beats.text_vi: Lúc trước cô nói hai chỗ. Ta đã đổi ngay rồi sao?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: You're right. Two first. We can discuss four another day.
beats.text_vi: Cậu nói đúng. Trước tiên hai chỗ. Chuyện bốn chỗ để ngày khác.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: I'm not trying to catch you. I need instructions that hold.
beats.text_vi: Cháu không bắt bẻ cô. Cháu cần chỉ dẫn nhất quán thôi.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Then two seats hold. I can live with two seats.
beats.text_vi: Vậy chốt hai ghế. Tôi chấp nhận hai ghế được.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.stage_action: Sam places the folded cloth beside the two empty cup spaces, leaving both spaces clear.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: We should put the short menu somewhere people can read.
beats.text_vi: Nên đặt thực đơn ngắn ở chỗ mọi người đọc được.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: I'll explain it before they sit. That's my job today.
beats.text_vi: Tôi sẽ giải thích trước khi họ ngồi. Hôm nay đó là việc tôi.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: And I keep this bit ready without promising anything extra.
beats.text_vi: Còn cháu giữ khu này sẵn sàng, không tự hứa thêm gì.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Exactly. If we're slow, we say we're slow, without excuses.
beats.text_vi: Đúng. Nếu làm chậm, ta nói là chậm, không viện cớ.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: I can say that. I don't want to invent answers.
beats.text_vi: Cháu nói được. Cháu không muốn bịa câu trả lời đâu.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Neither do I. We can leave the bigger menu put away.
beats.text_vi: Tôi cũng vậy. Cứ cất thực đơn đầy đủ đi đã.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

scenes.title: One week's money
scenes.goal: Sam tests whether a trial is funded or merely hopeful.
scenes.outcome: They identify a finite wage reserve and agree it cannot become Sam's investment.
scenes.setup_en: RUTH is seated on the far booth seat; SAM is seated on the near booth seat. Props are preset between scenes; there are no other visible or audible people.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: If we're discussing a week, I need numbers for that.
beats.text_vi: Nếu đang bàn một tuần, cháu cần biết con số cụ thể.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Five mornings, three hours each. Nothing on the weekend yet.
beats.text_vi: Năm buổi sáng, mỗi buổi ba tiếng. Cuối tuần chưa tính gì.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: That's fifteen hours. At fifteen, you'd need two hundred twenty five.
beats.text_vi: Là mười lăm giờ. Giá mười lăm thì cần hai trăm hai mươi lăm.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: I have that much set aside. It includes today's forty five.
beats.text_vi: Tôi có để riêng đủ số đó, kể cả bốn mươi lăm hôm nay.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Is that money needed for a bill that's due tomorrow?
beats.text_vi: Số tiền đó có cần cho hóa đơn đến hạn ngày mai không?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Not tomorrow. The rent is the bill I'm worried about.
beats.text_vi: Không phải ngày mai. Tiền thuê mới là hóa đơn khiến tôi lo.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Would paying me mean you can't pay the rent afterward?
beats.text_vi: Trả lương cháu có làm cô không trả nổi tiền thuê sau đó không?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.stage_action: Ruth places one wage calculation sheet on her own side of the booth table.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: The rent was a problem before you walked in here.
beats.text_vi: Tiền thuê đã là vấn đề từ trước khi cậu bước vào.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: That doesn't answer whether a week makes the problem worse.
beats.text_vi: Như vậy chưa trả lời một tuần có làm vấn đề tệ hơn không.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: It costs money. Staying shut also costs money every day.
beats.text_vi: Nó tốn tiền. Đóng cửa cũng vẫn tốn tiền mỗi ngày.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: I don't want you calling my wages another favour later.
beats.text_vi: Cháu không muốn sau này cô gọi tiền lương là một ân huệ nữa.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: They aren't a favour. They're the cost of asking you here.
beats.text_vi: Đó không phải ân huệ. Đó là chi phí để thuê cậu đến.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Then keep the full week separate before we call it agreed.
beats.text_vi: Vậy hãy để riêng đủ tiền cả tuần trước khi chốt thỏa thuận.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: That's reasonable. But I can't reserve another week behind it.
beats.text_vi: Hợp lý. Nhưng tôi không thể để dành tiếp cho tuần sau nữa.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: I'm not asking for another week. I'm asking about this one.
beats.text_vi: Cháu không đòi tuần sau. Cháu đang hỏi đúng tuần này.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Two hundred twenty five. Paid each morning, not after Friday.
beats.text_vi: Hai trăm hai mươi lăm. Trả từng sáng, không đợi qua thứ Sáu.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.stage_action: Sam studies Ruth's face in a still close-up, taking time before his next question.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: If we stop early, we settle the hours already worked?
beats.text_vi: Nếu nghỉ sớm, ta thanh toán số giờ đã làm rồi chứ?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Yes. And if I cancel, I tell you before you travel.

beats.text_en: By five fifteen, please. After that, I've already left home.

beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Five fifteen. I'll keep the number by the phone here.
beats.text_vi: Năm giờ mười lăm. Tôi sẽ để số điện thoại cạnh máy ở đây.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: If I can't come, I call then too, not just disappear.
beats.text_vi: Nếu không đến được, cháu cũng gọi giờ đó, không tự nhiên biến mất.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: After each morning, ten minutes to say what didn't work.
beats.text_vi: Sau mỗi buổi sáng, dành mười phút nói điều gì chưa ổn.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Inside the paid time. I don't want that sliding afterward.
beats.text_vi: Trong thời gian có lương. Cháu không muốn nó trượt ra sau ca.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Inside it. We stop serving early enough to finish by nine.
beats.text_vi: Trong ca. Ta ngừng phục vụ đủ sớm để xong trước chín giờ.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: At the end, we decide whether another week makes sense.
beats.text_vi: Cuối tuần thử việc, ta quyết định có nên làm thêm tuần nữa.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.stage_action: Sam holds a quiet, deliberate expression in a static close-up before continuing the agreement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Either of us can say no. We settle what's been worked.
beats.text_vi: Ai cũng được nói không. Ta thanh toán phần đã làm.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: And I don't lose today's pay if tomorrow doesn't happen.
beats.text_vi: Và cháu không mất lương hôm nay nếu ngày mai không tiếp tục.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: You don't. I'm paying for work, not for keeping promises forever.
beats.text_vi: Không mất. Tôi trả tiền công, không mua lời hứa mãi mãi.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: You don't have to guarantee the place will still be here.
beats.text_vi: Cô không phải bảo đảm quán vẫn sẽ còn ở đây.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: I can't guarantee that. I can tell you what I know.
beats.text_vi: Tôi không bảo đảm được. Tôi có thể nói điều mình biết.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Tell me when it changes, before I'm standing outside again.
beats.text_vi: Khi có thay đổi, báo cháu trước khi cháu lại đứng ngoài cửa.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: I will. I won't leave you reading another notice first.
beats.text_vi: Tôi sẽ báo. Tôi không để cậu phải đọc thông báo trước nữa.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Then I want the week. I don't need a bigger promise.
beats.text_vi: Vậy cháu nhận tuần này. Cháu không cần lời hứa lớn hơn.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: I'd like the week too. Even knowing it might not work.
beats.text_vi: Tôi cũng muốn thử một tuần. Dù biết có thể không thành.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: We can find that out without pretending we've already solved it.
beats.text_vi: Ta có thể tìm hiểu mà không giả vờ đã giải quyết xong.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Agreed. We'll check the work, the hours, and the money.
beats.text_vi: Thống nhất. Ta kiểm tra công việc, giờ làm và tiền bạc.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains seated on the far booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: All right. Tell me where you'd like me to start.
beats.text_vi: Được rồi. Cô nói cháu biết cô muốn cháu bắt đầu từ đâu.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains seated on the near booth seat in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

scenes.title: The first task
scenes.goal: They begin a modest real shift instead of celebrating a rescue.
scenes.outcome: Sam places an OPEN card on the counter; the trial begins and the diner's future stays uncertain.
scenes.setup_en: RUTH is standing behind the counter; SAM is standing on the customer side. Props are preset between scenes; there are no other visible or audible people.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: First, put that cup back. I can never find one.
beats.text_vi: Trước hết đặt cốc lại nhé. Tôi cứ chẳng tìm thấy cốc nào.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: The cup's already there. You're looking past it at me.
beats.text_vi: Cốc ở đó rồi. Cô đang nhìn qua nó để nhìn cháu.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: So it is. I'm going to have to get used to this.
beats.text_vi: Đúng thế thật. Tôi sẽ phải tập quen với chuyện này.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Having the cups ready, or somebody telling you where they are?
beats.text_vi: Quen với cốc sẵn sàng, hay có người chỉ cho cô chỗ để?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Both, probably. Don't expect me to be graceful about it.
beats.text_vi: Chắc là cả hai. Đừng mong lúc nào tôi cũng nhẹ nhàng nhé.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: I wasn't. I'd like instructions more than graceful, to start.
beats.text_vi: Cháu không mong vậy. Trước tiên cháu cần chỉ dẫn hơn sự nhẹ nhàng.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: The clean cloth stays here. The other one stays behind me.
beats.text_vi: Khăn sạch để đây. Chiếc còn lại ở phía sau tôi.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: And nothing hot on the lower shelf. I remember that.
beats.text_vi: Không đặt đồ nóng ở ngăn dưới. Cháu vẫn nhớ điều đó.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Good. We'll check the two places before we open anything.
beats.text_vi: Tốt. Ta kiểm tra hai chỗ trước khi mở cửa phục vụ.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: What time do you want to start serving this morning?
beats.text_vi: Sáng nay cô muốn bắt đầu phục vụ lúc mấy giờ ạ?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Seven. That gives us time to get the counter ready.
beats.text_vi: Bảy giờ. Như vậy có thời gian chuẩn bị quầy cho xong.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Then we should say seven, rather than let people guess.
beats.text_vi: Vậy nên ghi bảy giờ, đừng để mọi người phải đoán.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: I'll put the hours by the door before we serve.
beats.text_vi: Tôi sẽ để giờ mở cửa cạnh cửa trước lúc phục vụ.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Do you want the old notice put away for now?
beats.text_vi: Cô có muốn tạm cất tờ thông báo cũ đi không?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Leave it folded on the back counter. Don't throw it out.
beats.text_vi: Cứ để nó gấp lại ở quầy sau. Đừng vứt đi.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: All right. We don't have to decide what happens afterward.
beats.text_vi: Được. Ta chưa cần quyết định chuyện gì xảy ra sau đó.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: And if this feels wrong tomorrow, you'll tell me then?
beats.text_vi: Nếu ngày mai thấy không ổn, cậu sẽ nói với tôi chứ?
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Yes. Will you tell me, instead of printing another notice?
beats.text_vi: Vâng. Cô cũng nói với cháu, thay vì in thông báo nữa chứ?
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: I'll tell you. Probably over coffee that actually has coffee in it.
beats.text_vi: Tôi sẽ nói. Chắc khi uống cà phê có cà phê thật trong cốc.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: I'd settle for knowing which mug you're putting mine in.
beats.text_vi: Cháu chỉ cần biết cô định rót phần cháu vào chiếc cốc nào.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: The one on your side. I can keep that much straight.
beats.text_vi: Chiếc phía cậu. Chừng đó thì tôi vẫn phân biệt được.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text_en: Good. I'll leave it there until you need the space.
beats.text_vi: Tốt. Cháu cứ để đó đến khi cô cần chỗ trống.
beats.stage_action: SAM remains standing on the customer side in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: There's a small open card beside the till. Use that one.
beats.text_vi: Có thẻ mở cửa nhỏ cạnh máy tính tiền. Dùng tấm đó nhé.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: RUTH
beats.text_en: Put it here on the counter, where we can see it.
beats.text_vi: Đặt nó ở đây trên quầy, chỗ chúng ta nhìn thấy được.
beats.stage_action: RUTH remains standing behind the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to the other actor offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The listener is silent. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.stage_action: Sam sets a small freestanding OPEN card on the clear counter; only his own hand touches it. Ruth stays still, well clear of his reach.
